drc-2002-mining-code.verified: Table 5 is titled 'Democratic Republic of the Congo: PRGF-Supported Three-Year Program Prior Actions' and lists 'Publication of the new mining code' with 'Before end-April 2002'. Table 2 is 'Structural Performance Benchmarks under the SMP' and under 'By September 30, 2001' lists 'Finalize the investment code and the mining code prepared with World Bank assistance'. Both quotes appear on the page.
drc-2002-mining-code.changed: Dropped type 'invest' and its why entry. Text unchanged.
drc-2002-mining-code.why: The investment-code wording is a benchmark under the staff-monitored programme, which carried no IMF money, so it does not show that money depended on an investment code. The mining-code prior action for the three-year PRGF arrangement stands, so 'law' is kept.

lahore-north-grid-station-farmland.verified: The first PDF is ADB's Facility Administration Manual for Pakistan: Second Power Transmission Enhancement Investment Program and Tranche 1 (48078-002, August 2016). Para 59 contains verbatim 'Clearance of the sectional LARP monitoring reports by ADB is a prerequisite for commencing civil works activities' and the requirement that LARPs for each contract package be finalized and submitted to ADB for review. Para 61 contains 'obtain all regulatory clearances from the concerned environmental protection agency (provincial) before starting civil works' and 'include EMPs in bidding documents for future contracts'. The second PDF is the Tranche 3 external/social monitoring report, cover 'Loan number: 3677', para 11 containing verbatim 'the loan covenants require that land acquisition and resettlement instruments be monitored internally and externally'.
lahore-north-grid-station-farmland.changed: Added 'and its first tranche' so the manual is not presented as a tranche 3 document. Type kept.
lahore-north-grid-station-farmland.why: The manual read is the facility/tranche 1 manual; the loan-covenant sentence for Loan 3677 comes from the tranche 3 monitoring report. Both are loan-specific terms, not a general policy, so 'safeguard' stands.

asuncion-metrobus-frentistas.verified: The mirrored PDF is the genuine document: 'Compliance Review Report, Program for Downtown Redevelopment, Modernization of Metropolitan Public Transport, and Government Offices (PR-L1044, PR-L1056, PR-T1174)', MICI of the IDB, case MICI-BID-PR-2016-0101, 2018. Para 2.6 says the three municipios were ones 'with which the MOPC was to sign agreements to ensure the program's viability prior to tendering contracts', and that the agreements were to 'specifically make reference to the active participation of these parties in the design, implementation, and support of the communication, relocation, resettlement, and economic redevelopment plans of the various affected parties'. Footnote 26 cites 'Loan contract, special provisions, clause 3.03(f)'. The report states 'the program was approved without an environmental and social management plan (ESMP)' and that 'the operation lacked a resettlement plan before its approval'.
asuncion-metrobus-frentistas.changed: Added that the agreements were to be signed before contracts were tendered; changed 'was issued only in 2016' to 'was prepared in 2016'. Type kept.
asuncion-metrobus-frentistas.why: Mirror confirmed authentic. The source says the master plan was prepared in 2016, not 'issued only in'. The requirement is a clause of this loan contract, so 'safeguard' stands.

marena-renovables-san-dionisio.verified: The UNAM-hosted PDF is the IDB's own Environmental and Social Action Plan for the Marena Renovables Wind Power Project, ME-L1107, dated 5 December 2011 with action status updated 25 September 2012 - the document it claims to be. Item 5.4 contains verbatim 'As per the loan agreement, the client will remain in compliance with IDB's policies'. Items 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3 are due 'Prior to financial close' and cover updating land acquisition arrangements, finalising right-of-way negotiations and showing that pending land use permits were obtained. Item 1.8 requires 'Organize at least one consultation session with people from Santa Maria, San Dionisio, Alvaro Obregon'. Item 1.11 requires a grievance mechanism corresponding to best industry practice, citing IFC guidance. Items 1.15-1.18 require plans 'in substance and form satisfactory to IDB'.
marena-renovables-san-dionisio.changed: Replaced 'biodiversity' with 'the environment' in the last sentence and in the 'admin' why quote, and added the plan's 'in form and substance satisfactory to the IDB' wording. Types kept.
marena-renovables-san-dionisio.why: Items 1.15-1.18 are health and safety, traffic, emergency response and environmental management plans; biodiversity sits in a separate section and is not one of those submissions. The 'prior to financial close' items are conditions on this loan's money, so 'safeguard' stands, and the required grievance mechanism and lender-reviewed plans support 'admin'.

marsyangdi-corridor-lamjung.verified: Section 5.1.14 quotes Article 6.05(e) and contains verbatim 'implement and operate the Project in compliance with the Environmental and Social Standards', 'the updated Environmental and Social Management Plan and the RIPP' and 'obtain, maintain and comply with the requisite Environmental or Social Approvals for the Project'. Section 5.1.13 quotes Article 1.04B(iii) verbatim: '(A) completion of EIA procedures, and (B) confirmation of environmental approval(s) by the competent national authority in Nepal'.
marsyangdi-corridor-lamjung.changed: Rewrote the third sentence. The words put in quotation marks were not a quotation from the finance contract but the report's own summary, and the contract says 'a final EIA/IEE report (as applicable)', not 'final impact assessment report'. Type kept.
marsyangdi-corridor-lamjung.why: The two quoted contract articles are terms of this EIB finance contract, including a disbursement condition, so 'safeguard' stands.

green-resources-uganda-evictions.verified: The page says 'While all Performance Standards (PS) are applicable to this investment' and that the investment 'will have impacts which must be managed in a manner consistent with the following Performance Standards', then names PS1 to PS6. It contains no wording making those standards, or the Environmental Action Plan, a term, covenant or condition of this investment. The community engagement sentence 'GRL and SHI will plan and implement a robust community engagement program for SHI operations' is a description of what the companies will do, not a requirement. The Environmental Action Plan is listed under Client Documentation as 'GRAS EAP 10 March 2008.pdf' with a download link, so the researcher's statement that it is not published is also wrong, but its contents could not be read and so cannot support anything.
green-resources-uganda-evictions.changed: Blanked conditions_add, ct, why and sources_add.
green-resources-uganda-evictions.why: This is IFC's standard review-summary framing of Performance Standards that apply to all its investments, not a condition attached to this money. The only document that might have carried terms, the Environmental Action Plan, could not be read.

novi-sad-station-canopy-collapse.verified: The article says 'International agreements signed between the Serbian government and China's Exim Bank in May 2017 and April 2019' 'revealed that the modernization of two key railway sections was awarded to a Chinese consortium' 'consisting of China Railway International and China Communications Construction Company', and that 'These agreements, adopted by the Serbian parliament, were publicly available'. It says 'What remained inaccessible, however, were the commercial contracts'. The predetermination sentence appears verbatim: 'the selection of Chinese firms for the project was predetermined before the loan agreements were finalized'.
novi-sad-station-canopy-collapse.changed: Dropped type 'tied' and its why entry, rewrote the text to the source's own wording, and added the CHOICE source, which the entry had cited without listing.
novi-sad-station-canopy-collapse.why: The source does not say the loan required the Chinese consortium. It says the agreements 'revealed' an award that a separate July 2018 commercial contract had already settled before the loan agreements were finalised, which is the opposite of the loan imposing it. Text kept without a type.

gezhouba-shieli-cement-kodamanov.verified: The record contains verbatim 'China Gezhouba Group Cement Co., Ltd. proved a guarantee for the loan' ('proved' is AidData's own typo, quoted as printed) and 'overseas investment insurance that covered political risk up to 95%'. It gives a nine-year maturity and an original last scheduled repayment of 30 December 2025. No hedging on the guarantee.
gezhouba-shieli-cement-kodamanov.changed: Added the AidData source URL, which the entry had cited without listing. Text and type unchanged.
gezhouba-shieli-cement-kodamanov.why: A parent-company guarantee of the loan is repayment security, so 'repay' stands.

sahiwal-coal-plant-qadirabad.verified: The Collateral section records 'a pledge of shares in the project company [Huaneng Shandong Ruyi (Pakistan) Energy Ltd] by the equity holders' and 'a cash deposit worth PKR 50 billion from the Government of Pakistan in an escrow account' 'known as the Pakistan Energy Revolving Fund (PERF) at the State Bank of Pakistan'. The description gives 'a 5.26% Sinosure insurance premium'. The sovereign guarantee sentence appears verbatim in the description with no hedge, but the staff comments say 'AidData assumes that the loan captured in this record is backed by a sovereign guarantee' and that 'Pakistan's Ministry of Finance officially classifies all IPP debt as private debt'.
sahiwal-coal-plant-qadirabad.changed: Rewrote the sovereign-guarantee sentence to carry AidData's own 'assumes' wording. Added the AidData source URL. Type unchanged.
sahiwal-coal-plant-qadirabad.why: The uncertainty was only half carried: the Ministry of Finance point was there but not the fact that AidData is assuming the guarantee. 'repay' rests on the documented share pledge and escrow deposit, not on the guarantee, so it stands.

colombo-port-city-negombo-fishers.verified: Record 33431 says verbatim 'the loan is collateralized against CHEC's equity stake in CHEC Port City Colombo (Pvt.) Ltd. and sales revenues generated by the project', 'The loan is also supported by a Sinosure credit insurance policy' and 'No sovereign guarantee was provided by the central government in support of the loan', all without hedging. Record 96170 says 'the proceeds of the loan were to be used to construct an underground tunnel and access road', introduced by 'it is known that' and in the conditional.
colombo-port-city-negombo-fishers.changed: Dropped type 'fincov' and its why entry. Added both AidData source URLs. Text unchanged.
colombo-port-city-negombo-fishers.why: The use-of-proceeds line is the loan's stated purpose, hedged by AidData, not a documented covenant restricting what the money could be spent on. 'repay' is carried by the equity and revenue collateral, which the record states flatly, so it stands. The record's statement that no sovereign guarantee was given is about a guarantee, not about conditions generally, so it does not make this a 'none' case.

chancay-port-fishers-houses.verified: The record's collateral field reads 'Shares of CSP Chancay, an all-assets pledge, an accounts pledge, a land and concession mortgage' plus 'direct agreements with project contractors', and names Bank of China as security/collateral agent. It gives a 15-year maturity, signing on 28 March 2023, '72.22% of the $1.3 billion cost of Phase 1' and 'SOFR rate (simple daily average) plus 1.93% margin'. Hedging in the record applies to each bank's individual share, which the entry does not state.
chancay-port-fishers-houses.changed: Added the AidData source URL. Text and type unchanged.
chancay-port-fishers-houses.why: A pledge of shares, assets, accounts and a concession mortgage is repayment security, so 'repay' stands.
